scripts.check:firebase:rules: npm run test:rules:firestore && npm run test:rules:database && npm run test:rules:storage
scripts.check:outdated: ncu --packageFile package.json --format group,installedVersion --cooldown 7d && ncu --packageFile functions/package.json --format group,installedVersion --cooldown 7d
scripts.check:cycles: npm run check:cycles:app && npm run check:cycles:functions
scripts.check:ui:audits: npm run build && cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_USE_BUILD=1 playwright test tests/ui-audits/runtime.spec.ts tests/ui-audits/accessibility.spec.ts tests/ui-audits/visual-regression.spec.ts --project=chromium --project="Mobile Chrome"
scripts.check:ui:runtime: npm run agent:ui-index && tsx scripts/agent/build-ui-runtime-audit.ts && npm run check:ui:mobile-doctrine && npm run check:not-found
scripts.check:ui:continuity: npm run agent:ui-index && npm run check:ui:coverage && npm run check:ui:runtime && npm run check:ui:audits && npm run check:ui:lighthouse

scripts.check:continuity: npm run check:architecture && npm run check:inventory && npm run check:cycles && npm run check:route-runtime-parity && npm run check:generated-artifacts && npm run check:dependency-truth
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit --pretty && eslint . --max-warnings=0 && npm run check:architecture && npm run check:telemetry && npm run check:analytics-semantics && npm run check:firebase-runtime && npm run check:admin-truth-replacement && npm run test:contracts
scripts.check:consistency: npm run check && npm run check:deps && npm run check:versions && npm run check:inventory && npm run check:cycles && npm run check:functions
